purpose: Schedule the governed P18-P26 completion programme in parallel where independent national pipelines are already defensible, without changing phase semantics, the 20,115-slot denominator, evidence standards or final acceptance gates.
invariants: P18-P26 phase IDs, outputs and acceptance gates remain authoritative in data/data-completion-roadmap.json.
Parallel execution may resolve only slot instances already present in the canonical completeness ledger.
No accelerator or pilot creates a second denominator or a duplicate governed slot.

No county value may be inherited into a constituency and no constituency/county value may be inherited into a ward unless an indicator policy explicitly permits a transparent derived cross-level measure.
Primary official sources remain preferred and all promoted observations retain source, reference period, unit, geography and derivation metadata.
A pilot may leave a governed slot unresolved when evidence or geography is insufficient; it must never fabricate completion.
Full phase completion still requires the original phase acceptance gate even if some of its slots were resolved earlier by an accelerator.
P24 cannot claim completion before full P23 acceptance, and P26 remains the final convergence gate.

tracks.label: County completion
tracks.rule: P21 and P22 are closed. P22 completed with all 66 governed slots resolved through date-aware direct evidence or explicit evidence-constrained closure; stale drought warnings, expired food-security phases and unsupported county anomaly values were not promoted as current.

tracks.label: Local intelligence accelerator
tracks.rule: P22 is closed. Promote reusable national constituency pipelines through P23A, beginning with registered voters, but resolve only existing P23 slots and retain full P23 as the 290-constituency completion gate.

tracks.label: Final convergence
tracks.rule: Ward completion, final public-surface closure and the permanent 100% gate retain their original dependencies and acceptance semantics.

P23A.name: Constituency national-pipeline pilot
P23A.goal: Prove reusable, nationally reconcilable constituency pipelines while preserving the full P23 acceptance gate.
initial_pipeline_order: official turnout history where citable and comparable
NG-CDF utilisation or implementation only where a nationally comparable official source exists

first_tranche.source_family: IEBC 2022 General Election registered-voter Gazette Notice No. 7290
first_tranche.statistical_authority_schedule: First Schedule — Registered Voters per County Assembly Ward
first_tranche.published_constituency_schedule: Second Schedule — Registered Voters per Constituency
first_tranche.canonical_treatment: B — Official derived; exact sum of all official IEBC child ward rows for each constituency, including source rows withheld only from uncertain ward geometry
first_tranche.readiness: 290/290 constituency totals and the anti-inheritance/boundary-hold contract are audited in Sprint 2; promotion contract is active and native canonical P23 builder remains the next atomic implementation tranche

acceptance: Only primary/official or explicitly governed extraction artifacts with primary-source authority may support promoted values.
All promoted constituency rows reconcile to the canonical 290-constituency geography registry.
Registered-voter constituency values preserve the audited B — Official derived Sprint 2 treatment unless a separate direct-schedule ingestion is independently validated.
Election and boundary vintage are explicit.
Only pre-existing P23 governed slots are resolved; total_slots remains 20,115.
Any partial or unresolved mapping remains visibly unresolved rather than being force-matched.
Each promoted family has a deterministic builder and validator.
Full Atlas build, validation and P16 gates pass before merge.

next_actions: Implement the native P23A registered-voter builder for exactly 290 constituency IND-REGISTERED-VOTERS slots using the audited Sprint 2 B — Official derived treatment and the active promotion contract.
After the 290-voter tranche is green, add official constituency turnout history only where election period and denominator are explicit and comparable.
Resolve the current MP identity roster through a nationally reconcilable authoritative source with explicit office/election vintage.
Design NG-CDF allocation ingestion with fiscal-year provenance before attempting utilisation/implementation metrics.
Do not start ward numeric promotion until P23 acceptance and an independently defensible ward geography/source contract are satisfied.
